close_reason: Added msrv CI job using dtolnay/rust-toolchain@1.88.0 + cargo check --workspace --all-features --locked. The declared MSRV (1.88) now has CI coverage; a future transitive-dep update that silently raises the actual MSRV will fail this job. YAML validated. Commit pending.
description:
Plan C deferred from JMAP-sc1b.9. The workspace declares rust-version = "1.75" in Cargo.toml [workspace.package]. CI must verify the workspace actually compiles with the declared MSRV, otherwise a transitive-dep update could silently bump the minimum supported Rust version without us noticing.

Implementation hint: add a single 'msrv' job using dtolnay/rust-toolchain@1.75 and run 'cargo check --workspace --all-features --locked'. Use --locked to prevent surprise dep upgrades during the check.

Note: MSRV check is build-only (cargo check), not test. Some test-only features (e.g. wiremock) may require newer Rust; that is acceptable as long as library crates' build paths are MSRV-clean.

Closes the MSRV TODO comment in .github/workflows/ci.yml.
notes: 2026-05-08: Investigation discovered declared MSRV 1.75 does not match actual MSRV (~1.86 minimum, 1.88 confirmed working). Failure modes: Rust 1.75 fails on hashbrown 0.17.0 needing edition2024; Rust 1.85 fails on icu_*@2.2.0 needing rustc 1.86. Blocked on JMAP-ulfy (decision: bump declared MSRV vs pin deps vs drop MSRV declaration). Will resume once JMAP-ulfy resolved.
title: CI: add MSRV (1.75) build check
